$$

feedback.problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
x=2t,\,\,\,y=\frac{5}{t},\,t>0
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We need to create a table of values and then sketch the curve. First, we work out the $x$-values using the formula $x=2t.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $0.5$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ | $8$ | $10$ |
| $y$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ |

$$

$$

Now, we work out the $y$ values using $y=\frac{5}{t}.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $0.5$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ | $8$ | $10$ |
| $y$ | $10$ | $5$ | $2.5$ | $1.67$ | $1.25$ | $1$ |

$$

$$
